text: MUST not weigh less than five ounces and a half, nor more than five ounces and three quarters.
text_norm: must not weigh less than five ounces and a half, nor more than five ounces and three quarters.

text: It cannot be changed during the game, but with consent of both parties.
text_norm: it cannot be changed during the game, but with consent of both parties.

text: Must not exceed four inches and one quarter in the widest part.
text_norm: must not exceed four inches and one quarter in the widest part.

text: Must be twenty-two inches, and the bail six inches long; but by a subsequent meeting it is settled for to use three stumps instead of two, to each wicket, and the two bails not to exceed six inches.
text_norm: must be twenty-two inches, and the bail six inches long; but by a subsequent meeting it is settled for to use three stumps instead of two, to each wicket, and the two bails not to exceed six inches.

text: Must be parallel with the stumps, three feet in length, with a return-crease.
text_norm: must be parallel with the stumps, three feet in length, with a return-crease.

text: Must be three feet ten inches from the wickets; and the wickets must be opposite to each other, at the distance of twenty-two yards.
text_norm: must be three feet ten inches from the wickets; and the wickets must be opposite to each other, at the distance of twenty-two yards.

law_title: The Party which goes from Home
text: Shall have the choice of the innings and the pitching of the wickets, which shall be pitched within thirty yards of a centre fixed by the adversaries.
text_norm: shall have the choice of the innings and the pitching of the wickets, which shall be pitched within thirty yards of a centre fixed by the adversaries.

law_title: The Party which goes from Home
text: When the parties meet at a third place, the bowlers shall toss up for the pitching of the first wicket, and the choice of going in.
text_norm: when the parties meet at a third place, the bowlers shall toss up for the pitching of the first wicket, and the choice of going in.

text: Must deliver the ball with one foot behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease; and shall bowl four balls before he changes wickets, which he shall do but once in the same innings.
text_norm: must deliver the ball with one foot behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease; and shall bowl four balls before he changes wickets, which he shall do but once in the same innings.

text: He may order the player at his wicket to stand on which side of it he pleases.
text_norm: he may order the player at his wicket to stand on which side of it he pleases.

text: If either of the bails are bowled off, or the stump bowled out of the ground.
text_norm: if either of the bails are bowled off, or the stump bowled out of the ground.

text: Or if the ball, from a stroke over or under his bat, or upon his hands (but not wrists) is held before it touches the ground, though it be hugged to the body of the catcher.
text_norm: or if the ball, from a stroke over or under his bat, or upon his hands (but not wrists) is held before it touches the ground, though it be hugged to the body of the catcher.

text: Or if, in striking, both his feet are over the popping-crease, and his wicket is put down, except his bat is grounded within it.
text_norm: or if, in striking, both his feet are over the popping-crease, and his wicket is put down, except his bat is grounded within it.

text: Or if he runs out of his ground to hinder a catch.
text_norm: or if he runs out of his ground to hinder a catch.

text: Or if a ball is struck up, and he wilfully strike it again.
text_norm: or if a ball is struck up, and he wilfully strike it again.

text: Or if the striker touches or takes up the ball before it has lain still, unless at the request of the opposite party.
text_norm: or if the striker touches or takes up the ball before it has lain still, unless at the request of the opposite party.

text: Or if in running a notch, the wicket is struck down by a throw, or with the ball in hand, before his foot, hand, or bat, is grounded over the popping-crease; but if the bail is off, a stump must be struck out of the ground by the ball.
text_norm: or if in running a notch, the wicket is struck down by a throw, or with the ball in hand, before his foot, hand, or bat, is grounded over the popping-crease; but if the bail is off, a stump must be struck out of the ground by the ball.

text: Or if the striker puts his leg before the wicket with a design to stop the ball, and actually prevents the ball from hitting his wicket by it.
text_norm: or if the striker puts his leg before the wicket with a design to stop the ball, and actually prevents the ball from hitting his wicket by it.

text: If the players have crossed each other, he that runs for the wicket that is put down, is out; if they are not crossed, he that has left the wicket that is put down, is out.
text_norm: if the players have crossed each other, he that runs for the wicket that is put down, is out; if they are not crossed, he that has left the wicket that is put down, is out.

text: When the ball has been in the bowlers or wicket-keeper’s hands, the strikers need not keep within their ground till the umpire has called play; but if the player goes out of his ground, with an intent to run before the ball is delivered, the bowler may put him out.
text_norm: when the ball has been in the bowlers or wicket-keeper's hands, the strikers need not keep within their ground till the umpire has called play; but if the player goes out of his ground, with an intent to run before the ball is delivered, the bowler may put him out.

text: If he strikes, or treads down, or falls himself upon his wicket in striking (but not in over-running), its out.
text_norm: if he strikes, or treads down, or falls himself upon his wicket in striking (but not in over-running), its out.

text: When the ball is struck up in the running-ground, between the wickets, it is lawful for the strikers to hinder its being catched; but they must neither strike at, nor touch the ball with their hands.
text_norm: when the ball is struck up in the running-ground, between the wickets, it is lawful for the strikers to hinder its being catched; but they must neither strike at, nor touch the ball with their hands.

text: If the ball is struck up, the striker may guard his wicket either with his bat or his body.
text_norm: if the ball is struck up, the striker may guard his wicket either with his bat or his body.

text: Shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the wicket, and shall not move till the ball is out of the bowler’s hand, and shall not, by any noise, incommode the striker; and if his hands, knees, foot, or head, be over or before the wicket, though the ball hit it, it shall not be out.
text_norm: shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the wicket, and shall not move till the ball is out of the bowler's hand, and shall not, by any noise, incommode the striker; and if his hands, knees, foot, or head, be over or before the wicket, though the ball hit it, it shall not be out.

text: Shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each innings; when the umpire shall call play, the party refusing to play shall lose the match.
text_norm: shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each innings; when the umpire shall call play, the party refusing to play shall lose the match.

text: They are the sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them When a striker is hurt, they are to allow another to come in, and the person hurt shall have his place in any part of that innings.
text_norm: they are the sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them when a striker is hurt, they are to allow another to come in, and the person hurt shall have his place in any part of that innings.

text: They are not to order a player out, unless appealed to by the adversaries.
text_norm: they are not to order a player out, unless appealed to by the adversaries.

text: But if the bowler’s foot is not behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease, when he delivers the ball, the umpire, unasked, must call no ball.
text_norm: but if the bowler's foot is not behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease, when he delivers the ball, the umpire, unasked, must call no ball.

text: If the strikers run a short notch, the umpire must call no notch.
text_norm: if the strikers run a short notch, the umpire must call no notch.

text: If the notches of one player are laid against another, the bet depends on both innings, unless otherwise specified.
text_norm: if the notches of one player are laid against another, the bet depends on both innings, unless otherwise specified.

text: If one party beats the other in one innings, the notches in the first innings shall determine the bet.
text_norm: if one party beats the other in one innings, the notches in the first innings shall determine the bet.

text: But if the party goes in a second time, then the bet must be determined by the number on the score.
text_norm: but if the party goes in a second time, then the bet must be determined by the number on the score.

text: If the striker moves out of his ground to strike at the ball, he shall be allowed no notch for such stroke, unless he returns to his ground after he has struck the ball.
text_norm: if the striker moves out of his ground to strike at the ball, he shall be allowed no notch for such stroke, unless he returns to his ground after he has struck the ball.
